intro.text:
Multifield Component Demo

This page demonstrates the Author and Book components with multifield functionality.

author-section-title.text:
Author Component

The Author component displays author information with social links using the multifield widget.

author1.bio: Jane is a passionate software engineer with over 10 years of experience in building scalable web applications. She specializes in Java, Apache Sling, and content management systems.

author2.bio: John is a technical writer who loves making complex topics accessible to everyone. He has contributed to numerous open-source documentation projects.

book-section-title.text:
Book Component

The Book component displays book information with multiple authors using the multifield widget.

book1.subtitle: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship
book1.description: Even bad code can function. But if code isn't clean, it can bring a development organization to its knees. This book presents a revolutionary paradigm with Clean Code.

item_0.bio: Robert C. Martin (Uncle Bob) has been a programmer since 1970. He is the founder and president of Object Mentor Inc.

book2.subtitle: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software
book2.description: Capturing a wealth of experience about the design of object-oriented software, four top-notch designers present a catalog of simple and succinct solutions to commonly occurring design problems.

item_0.bio: Erich Gamma is a Swiss computer scientist and co-author of the influential software engineering textbook Design Patterns.

item_1.bio: Richard Helm is one of the Gang of Four who authored Design Patterns.

item_2.bio: Ralph Johnson is a Research Associate Professor in the Department of Computer Science at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.

item_3.bio: John Vlissides was a software scientist at IBM's Thomas J. Watson Research Center.

book3.subtitle: Your Journey to Mastery, 20th Anniversary Edition
book3.description: The Pragmatic Programmer is one of those rare tech books you'll read, re-read, and read again over the years.

item_0.bio: Dave Thomas is a programmer who likes to rock climb, fly, and cook.

item_1.bio: Andy Hunt is a programmer, author, and publisher.
